purpose: Clean digital summaries reconstructed from the author's reviewed notebook notes, not copies or facsimiles of the original photos.

pages.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a clean digital reference-note page for my Perplexity project. Create one finished portrait 2:3 note sheet. Plain white background, near-black crisp sans-serif typography, one restrained blue accent for a heading or key connection, generous margins and whitespace. Flat, precise, minimal editorial layout. Text is the content: render every required word accurately, with a clear hierarchy and comfortably large legible type. Simple thin-line boxes/arrows only where requested. No handwriting, paper texture, shadows, gradients, photos, hands, desks, doodles, logos, decorative icons, extra labels, invented facts, or watermark. Do not reproduce the original notebook photo. Only include the text and relationships specified below. Keep the footer small and unobtrusive.

Title: "Design approach"

"1. Understand the product"
"2. Define the main user"

"4. Separate core and future features"
"5. State requirements"
"6. Model components and data flow"
"7. Choose an MVP vertical slice"
"8. Design APIs after the design is clear"
"9. Build small with clean boundaries"
"10. Evolve version by version"
Footer: "Rewritten from IMG_1087 · Historical notes"
